subject: I built a website concept for BR Plumbing
body:
Hi Jason,

I came across BR Plumbing in Austin and put together a custom website concept for your business to show how your online presence could look with a cleaner, more conversion-focused layout.

You can view the live demo here:
https://br-plumbing-austin.muhammadmuneeb.tech/

I built it around your plumbing services and made it mobile-friendly so customers can quickly understand what you offer and contact you.

If you like the direction, I’d be happy to customize it further and turn it into a production website for BR Plumbing.

Best,
Muhammad Muneeb
https://muhammadmuneeb.tech/
